description: Tracks product launch buzz and reactions on Twitter using apidojo's Twitter Search scraper. Triggers when the user asks to: track product launch buzz on Twitter, monitor Twitter reactions to a product launch, measure product launch sentiment on X, find tweets about a new product release, track how a product launch is being received on Twitter, monitor competitor product announcements on Twitter, or analyze the social media impact of a product launch. Returns tweet volume, sentiment distribution, top voices, geographic spread, and buzz score. Ideal for product marketing teams, PR professionals, and competitive analysts monitoring launches.
